related.title: Sputnik／Transit：都卜勒追蹤的速度投影
related.titleEn: Sputnik/Transit: radial-velocity projection in Doppler tracking
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 3 m 與 2.7 m，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 3 m and 2.7 m, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋1000 Hz與2500 Hz，建立doppler_track.csv、徑向投影圖、振盪器偏置估計，並完成以下驗收：若追蹤搜尋窗±2 kHz，第二組需擴大離線搜尋或改預補償；不對衛星發送測試訊號。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 1000 Hz and 2500 Hz; create doppler_track.csv, radial projection and oscillator-offset estimates; apply this acceptance decision: A±2 kHz search window misses the second case; widen offline search or adjust prediction without transmitting toward a satellite.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 理想單側雙向測距ToF=(roundtrip-turnaround)/2，距離=c*ToF；兩時鐘尺度不一致會留下偏差。 展開基準式 (120-100)*0.000000001/2*300000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先扣轉向再除二，反推3 m應需20 ns往返傳播；額外2 ns紀錄誤差造成0.3 m偏移。 將兩條推導一起存入 uwb_timestamps.csv、轉向校正表、首徑證據。
從原理 低速近似頻移df=fr*vr/c，只感受徑向速度；軌道速度不能不經投影直接代入。 展開基準式 150000000*2000/300000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：把頻移反解vr；另加vr=0的橫向運動反例，一階頻移為零但衛星未靜止。 將兩條推導一起存入 doppler_track.csv、徑向投影圖、振盪器偏置估計。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Ideal single-sided TWR hasToF=(roundtrip-turnaround)/2 and distance=c*ToF; mismatched clock scales leave bias., expand baseline expression (120-100)*0.000000001/2*300000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Subtract turnaround before halving;3 m implies20 ns round-trip propagation and2 ns record error causes0.3 m bias. Save both derivations with uwb_timestamps.csv, turnaround corrections and first-path evidence.

Starting from For low speeds,df=fr*vr/c depends on radial velocity; orbital speed needs projection before substitution., expand baseline expression 150000000*2000/300000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Invert shift to recovervr; include transverse motion withvr=0, giving zero first-order shift without a stationary satellite. Save both derivations with doppler_track.csv, radial projection and oscillator-offset estimates.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: DVB-S2 衛星廣播：MODCOD 與淨資料率
related.titleEn: DVB-S2 satellite broadcast: MODCOD and useful data rate
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 3 m 與 2.7 m，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 3 m and 2.7 m, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋9 Mbit/s useful estimate與18 Mbit/s useful estimate，建立dvbs2_modcod.csv、每符元資訊表、模式回退證據，並完成以下驗收：15 Mbit/s需求只第二組名義通過，但若缺可靠度證據不能選該MODCOD。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 9 Mbit/s useful estimate and 18 Mbit/s useful estimate; create dvbs2_modcod.csv, information-per-symbol table and mode-fallback evidence; apply this acceptance decision: Only the second nominally meets15 Mbit/s, but it cannot be selected without reliability evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 理想單側雙向測距ToF=(roundtrip-turnaround)/2，距離=c*ToF；兩時鐘尺度不一致會留下偏差。 展開基準式 (120-100)*0.000000001/2*300000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先扣轉向再除二，反推3 m應需20 ns往返傳播；額外2 ns紀錄誤差造成0.3 m偏移。 將兩條推導一起存入 uwb_timestamps.csv、轉向校正表、首徑證據。

從原理 調變bits/symbol乘碼率再扣框架效率得到近似淨率；MODCOD的可靠度還需對應接收條件。 展開基準式 10*2*0.5*0.9；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先逐符元資訊1與2bit再乘率與效率；將PLHEADER等開銷另列，不把0.9視為所有DVB框固定值。 將兩條推導一起存入 dvbs2_modcod.csv、每符元資訊表、模式回退證據。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Ideal single-sided TWR hasToF=(roundtrip-turnaround)/2 and distance=c*ToF; mismatched clock scales leave bias., expand baseline expression (120-100)*0.000000001/2*300000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Subtract turnaround before halving;3 m implies20 ns round-trip propagation and2 ns record error causes0.3 m bias. Save both derivations with uwb_timestamps.csv, turnaround corrections and first-path evidence.

Starting from Approximate useful rate multiplies modulation bits, code rate and frame efficiency; MODCOD reliability also depends on reception conditions., expand baseline expression 10*2*0.5*0.9; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Compute1/2 information bits per symbol, then rate and efficiency;0.9 is a fixture, not a universal DVB frame constant. Save both derivations with dvbs2_modcod.csv, information-per-symbol table and mode-fallback evidence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
